summary: The note explains the origin of the name of Chen Peisi, which his father Chen Qiang chose in reference to Budapest, Hungary, where Chen Qiang performed "The White-Haired Girl" in 1951. It also notes that Chen's elder brother was named Chen Buda by the same father, following the same naming pattern.
one_line: Chen Peisi's name derives from Budapest, where his father Chen Qiang performed in 1951.
key_facts: Chen Peisi was named by his father Chen Qiang after Pest.
Chen Qiang performed "The White-Haired Girl" in Budapest, Hungary in 1951.
The name Chen Peisi is connected to the place Budapest, as the note describes it.
The pronunciation of "Budapest" in Mandarin Chinese is given in the note as a transliteration that is not reproduced here.
Chen's elder brother was named Chen Buda by Chen Qiang.
Chen Buda's name follows the same naming pattern as Chen Peisi's name, both derived from Budapest.
The note identifies Chen Qiang as the father who chose both sons' names.
